mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( email, user_name, user_role, nick_name, birth_date, phone_number, my_team, social_provider, gender ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{userName}, #{userRole, typeHandler=com.ssafy.ticket_backend.handler.UserRoleTypeHandler}, #{nickName}, #{birthDate}::date, #{phoneNumber}, #{myTeam, typeHandler=com.ssafy.ticket_backend.handler.BaseballTeamsTypeHandler}, #{socialProvider}, #{gender, typeHandler=com.ssafy.ticket_backend.handler.UserGenderTypeHandler} )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, user_name, email, nick_name, social_provider, profile_photo_url, gender, birth_date FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT email, user_name, nick_name, gender, profile_photo_url, my_team, phone_number, user_role, birth_date, transfer_number, receive_number, panelty_point FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET nick_name = #{nickName}, profile_photo_url = #{profileImageUrl}, my_team = #{myTeam, typeHandler=com.ssafy.ticket_backend.handler.BaseballTeamsTypeHandler}, gender = #{gender} WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.select: SELECT email FROM users WHERE is_block = FALSE AND is_delete = FALSE
SELECT nick_name FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
